documents.description: An array containing all the uploaded supporting documents held against the specified tax year and National Insurance number.

documentName.description: The name of the uploaded document.

selected.description: The uploaded document status. True means that it is to be included in the tax return.

selectionTimestamp.description: The time the uploaded document was selected to be included in the tax return. Must conform to the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ

uploadTimestamp.description: Date and time when the document upload process started. Must conform to the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ

lastUpdatedTimestamp.description: Date and time when the document was last updated. Must conform to the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ
